# InputRichMessageMedia

## Documentation

A media to be used in a rich message sent from Markdown or HTML, see
[`RichMessageSourceMarkdown`](RichMessageSourceMarkdown.md) and [`RichMessageSourceHtml`](RichMessageSourceHtml.md).

### Parameters

- **`id`** (`str`)
  Unique identifier of the media, by which the message text refers to it; 1-64 base64url characters
  (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, "-" and "_").

- **`media`** ([`InputMediaPhoto`](../input_media/InputMediaPhoto.md) | [`InputMediaVideo`](../input_media/InputMediaVideo.md) | [`InputMediaAnimation`](../input_media/InputMediaAnimation.md) | [`InputMediaAudio`](../input_media/InputMediaAudio.md) | [`InputMediaDocument`](../input_media/InputMediaDocument.md))
  The media to send: a local file, an HTTP URL or a file id. The caption of the input media is ignored.
